== Biography ==
He is from [[wikipedia:en:Belford Roxo, Rio de Janeiro|Belford Roxo]], Rio de Janeiro, a city located in the Baixada Fluminense region. He moved to São Paulo when he was young to compete for [[Ilha da Macacada Gaming]].
== Trivia ==
<tabber>
General Trivia=
===General Trivia===
* Chose his original nickname to show he was born in Rio de Janeiro (''carioca'' is the demonym used for people from that city).
** He later on stylized it to '''CarioK'''.
* Used to play as Midlaner.
* Known for his {{ci|Hecarim}}, {{ci|Lillia}}, {{ci|Udyr}}, {{ci|Lee Sin}} and {{ci|Graves}}.
* Reached top 2 in the European soloqueue (EUW) in 2019 during a bootcamp.
* He is the Brazilian player with the highest number of runners-up and appearances in finals, surpassing even [[Takeshi]] in the number of runners-up as of [[CBLOL 2024 Split 1 Playoffs|CBLOL 2024]].
* His 4-man sleep with {{ci|Lillia}} against [[RED Canids]] in the [[LTA South 2025 Split 2]] was featured in '''LoL Esports Plays of the Week'''.<ref>[https://x.com/lolesports/status/1912476597925605850 LoL Esports' X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
|-|
Non-League-related Trivia=
=== Non-League-related Trivia ===
* He is a Flamengo fan.<ref>[https://lolesports.com/article/fora-do-rift-cariok-aquele-que-representa/blt9be1aced74f38e26 Fora do Rift: CarioK, aquele que representa] ''lolesports.com''</ref>
* His sister, [https://liquipedia.net/valorant/Jubs Juliana], plays '''Valorant''' professionally in [https://liquipedia.net/valorant/MIBR_GC MIBR Female].<ref>[https://twitter.com/jubsvlr/status/1747274715503452410 Jubs' Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref>
* His parents are very active in social media supporting him. His father also plays League, is a OTP {{ci|garen}} and became a streamer.<ref>[https://twitter.com/Pairiok/status/1381972589803941888 Pairiok's Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref>
* During the [[LTA South 2025 Split 2|2nd split of the LTA South]], he discovered that he had nodular fasciitis on his face and played many games with a bandage on his face until he had surgery a few weeks before the finals.
|-|
Awards=
===Individual Awards===
* 1x CBLOL Best Jungler (Prêmio CBLOL 2020)
* 1x CBLOL 1st RR All-Pro Team (2024 Split 1)
* 1x LTAS Regular Season MVP (2025 Split 2)
